combo1.title: Gorgonic Umbral Horror: Going First into C104 Victory
combo1.description: The Beyond the Brave core from the one Gorgonic that is Level 4. All five new cards appear: Gorgonic, V, Thousand and Shining Umbral Horror build two Number 104: Masquerade V, and V Umbral Horror ranks the first one up into Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory from the Graveyard, with no Rank-Up-Magic Spell. Gorgonic counts as 2 of Masquerade V's 3 materials, and Shining does the same for the second copy. Nibiru is live once Thousand returns, the fifth summon. Starting hand: Gorgonic Umbral Horror + 1 card to discard (a spare Barian's Seal is best).

cards.name: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory

steps.text: Activate effect: Gorgonic Umbral Horror in your hand. You control no monsters, so it can summon itself.
Special Summon Gorgonic Umbral Horror. While it is face-up, the only monsters you can Special Summon from the Extra Deck are Number Xyz Monsters.
Add V Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand. Gorgonic can only add a non-Rock Umbral Horror, and V is a Spellcaster.
Normal Summon V Umbral Horror.
Activate effect: V Umbral Horror was Normal Summoned.
Add Thousand Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: Thousand Umbral Horror in your hand, as a Quick Effect.
Send Thousand Umbral Horror to the Graveyard as the cost.

Place Barian's Seventh Untopia from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone. It is placed, not activated, so nothing that negates a Spell's activation can answer it. Until the end of your next turn, Xyz Monsters are the only monsters you can bring out of your Extra Deck.
Activate effect: Barian's Seventh Untopia in your Field Zone.
Add Shining Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Discard Barian's Seal. On a later turn it can banish itself from the Graveyard to bring back 2 Umbral Horror monsters.
Xyz Summon Number 104: Masquerade V. It is a Number, so Gorgonic's restriction allows it.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror becomes material for Masquerade V. It counts as 2 of the 3 materials.
V Umbral Horror becomes the third material.
Activate effect: Shining Umbral Horror in your hand, because you brought out a Masquerade Xyz Monster.
Special Summon Shining Umbral Horror and draw 1 card. If you draw an Umbral Horror monster, you can Special Summon it too.
Activate effect: Thousand Umbral Horror in your Graveyard, because an Xyz Monster came out. It chains with Shining, since both respond to Masquerade V.
Special Summon Thousand Umbral Horror. For the rest of this turn, your own card effects deal you no damage.
Activate effect: Number 104: Masquerade V.
Detach V Umbral Horror as the cost.
Add Barian's Seal from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: V Umbral Horror in your Graveyard. Banish it and target Masquerade V.
Special Summon Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory from your Extra Deck with Masquerade V as its material. This is treated as an Xyz Summon.
Masquerade V becomes material for C104 Victory.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror transfers along with Masquerade V. It is now material, not a face-up monster, so its Number-only restriction has stopped.

Activate effect: C104 Victory gained Masquerade V's effect, because Masquerade V was on the field when it became material. Your opponent either banishes 4 monsters with different Attributes and 1 Spell from their Deck, or you banish the top 10 cards of their Deck.
Xyz Summon a second Number 104: Masquerade V.
Shining Umbral Horror becomes material. It counts as 2 of the 3 materials, just like Gorgonic.
Thousand Umbral Horror becomes the third material.
Activate effect: the second Masquerade V. Its detach effect is once per turn for each copy, not once per name.
Detach Thousand Umbral Horror as the cost. From the Graveyard it can return again on a later turn, whenever any Xyz Monster comes out.
Add Barian's Hope from your Deck to your hand. Next turn it brings back an Umbral Horror or a Masquerade Xyz Monster from your hand or Graveyard.
Set Barian's Seal. You control a Number C104, so it can negate your opponent's first card or effect next turn, then attach a monster to one of your Xyz Monsters.

End Phase: Barian's Seventh Untopia deals 400 damage per Xyz Monster on the field to each player. That is 800 to your opponent and none to you, because of Thousand. End board: C104 Victory (2 materials, a Quick Effect that destroys a card), Masquerade V (1 material), Untopia, a Set Barian's Seal, and Barian's Hope plus Shining's draw in hand.

combo2.title: Going Second: Two Rank-Ups and a C104 Victory Swing
combo2.description: Going second into a board. Gorgonic Umbral Horror summons itself on an empty field, and Shining joins on that summon. The line climbs to Rank 5 twice: V Umbral Horror turns the first Masquerade V into C104 Victory, whose Quick Effect destroys one card, and Rank-Up-Magic Limited Barian's Force turns the second into the 2013 Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade, which destroys a Spell or Trap when it arrives. Victory then wins its battle by 100 and halves your opponent's LP if they have a card in hand. Nibiru is live after Thousand returns, the fifth summon. Starting hand: Gorgonic Umbral Horror + Shining Umbral Horror.

cards.name: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory

steps.text: Activate effect: Gorgonic Umbral Horror in your hand. You are going second and control no monsters.
Special Summon Gorgonic Umbral Horror. While it is face-up, the only monsters you can Special Summon from the Extra Deck are Number Xyz Monsters.
Add V Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: Shining Umbral Horror in your hand, because you just brought out an Umbral Horror monster.
Special Summon Shining Umbral Horror and draw 1 card.
Normal Summon V Umbral Horror.
Activate effect: V Umbral Horror was Normal Summoned.
Add Thousand Umbral Horror from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: Thousand Umbral Horror in your hand, as a Quick Effect.
Send Thousand Umbral Horror to the Graveyard as the cost.

Place Barian's Seventh Untopia from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone. Until the end of your next turn, Xyz Monsters are the only monsters you can bring out of your Extra Deck, which this line never breaks.
Xyz Summon Number 104: Masquerade V.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror becomes material for Masquerade V. It counts as 2 of the 3 materials.
V Umbral Horror becomes the third material.
Activate effect: Thousand Umbral Horror in your Graveyard, because an Xyz Monster came out.
Special Summon Thousand Umbral Horror. For the rest of this turn, your own card effects deal you no damage.
Activate effect: Number 104: Masquerade V.
Detach V Umbral Horror as the cost.
Add Barian's Seal from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: V Umbral Horror in your Graveyard. Banish it and target Masquerade V.
Special Summon Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory from your Extra Deck with Masquerade V as its material. This is treated as an Xyz Summon.
Masquerade V becomes material for C104 Victory.
Gorgonic Umbral Horror transfers along with Masquerade V.
Activate effect: C104 Victory gained Masquerade V's effect. Your opponent banishes 4 monsters with different Attributes and 1 Spell from their Deck, or you banish their top 10 cards.
Activate effect: C104 Victory, as a Quick Effect.
Detach Gorgonic Umbral Horror as the cost, then destroy 1 card your opponent controls. Take out whatever would stop your attacks, such as a monster that negates or a Set card.
Xyz Summon a second Number 104: Masquerade V.
Shining Umbral Horror becomes material. It counts as 2 of the 3 materials.
Thousand Umbral Horror becomes the third material.
Activate effect: the second Masquerade V. Its detach effect is once per turn for each copy.
Detach Thousand Umbral Horror as the cost.
Add Rank-Up-Magic Limited Barian's Force from your Deck to your hand. Its name contains Barian's, so Masquerade V can find it.
Activate Rank-Up-Magic Limited Barian's Force, targeting the second Masquerade V.
Special Summon Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade from your Extra Deck with the second Masquerade V as its material. This is treated as an Xyz Summon.
The second Masquerade V becomes material for the 2013 C104.
Shining Umbral Horror transfers along with it. Masquerade V's banish effect is once per turn, so it doesn't happen again.
Rank-Up-Magic Limited Barian's Force goes to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade arrived on the field. Destroy 1 Spell or Trap. Its negation needs the 2013 Number 104: Masquerade as material, so it doesn't have that.
Set Barian's Seal for your opponent's turn. Either C104 keeps it live.

Battle Phase: C104 Victory attacks a monster. During damage calculation its ATK and DEF become that monster's higher stat + 100, so it wins. When it destroys the monster, send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard; if you do, their LP is halved.

The 2013 C104 attacks for 3000. End Phase: Untopia deals 400 per Xyz Monster on the field to each player; you take none, because of Thousand. End board: C104 Victory (1 material), the 2013 C104 (2 materials), Untopia and a Set Barian's Seal.

combo3.title: Classic Rank 3: Golem and Gargoyle into Gorgonic Guardian
combo3.description: The foundational combo from the Classic Gorgonic tab, played step by step. Normal Summon a Level 3 Rock, Gorgonic Gargoyle follows from the hand, and the two become Gorgonic Guardian, the archetype's Rank 3 boss. Keep Gorgonic Umbral Horror out of this turn: while it is face-up, Guardian can't be summoned, because it isn't a Number. Starting hand: Gorgonic Golem + Gorgonic Gargoyle.

steps.text: Normal Summon Gorgonic Golem, a Level 3 Rock monster. Any Level 3 Rock works here.
Activate effect: Gorgonic Gargoyle in your hand, because you Normal Summoned a Rock monster.
Special Summon Gorgonic Gargoyle.
Xyz Summon Gorgonic Guardian. It needs 2 Level 3 Rock monsters.
Gorgonic Golem becomes material for Gorgonic Guardian.
Gorgonic Gargoyle becomes the second material.

End board: Gorgonic Guardian with 2 materials. Once per turn, on either player's turn, detach 1 to make a face-up monster your opponent controls 0 ATK and negate its effects until the end of the turn. Once per turn, destroy a monster on the field with 0 ATK.
